How monospace text works

This is a Unicode alphabet, not a font download. A destination may use a fallback font, so equal-width appearance is not guaranteed after pasting.

Where it helps

For actual source code, use ordinary letters and a code block. Decorative mathematical characters are different identifiers and can break code or searches.
